spec.rawSql:
WITH latest_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        status,
        timestamp
    FROM sensor_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT
    machine_id,
    status
FROM latest_status
ORDER BY machine_id;

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "Time",
    machine_id AS "Machine",
    alert_type AS "Alert Type",
    message AS "Message",
    predicted_status AS "Predicted Status"
FROM ml_alerts
WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "Time",
    machine_id AS "Machine",
    event_type AS "Event Type",
    message AS "Message"
FROM maintenance_events
WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        health_score,
        maintenance_priority,
        risk_driver,
        recommended_action,
        failure_probability,
        current_status,
        predictive_state,
        timestamp
    FROM maintenance_assessments
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT
    machine_id AS "Machine",
    health_score AS "Health Score",
    maintenance_priority AS "Priority",
    risk_driver AS "Risk Driver",
    recommended_action AS "Recommended Action",
    ROUND((failure_probability * 100)::numeric, 1)
        AS "Failure Probability (%)"
FROM latest
ORDER BY health_score ASC;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        health_score
    FROM maintenance_assessments
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(health_score), 1) AS "Average Fleet Health"
FROM latest;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        maintenance_priority
    FROM maintenance_assessments
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "Machines Requiring Attention"
FROM latest
WHERE maintenance_priority IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL');

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        maintenance_priority
    FROM maintenance_assessments
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE maintenance_priority = 'LOW') AS "LOW",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE maintenance_priority = 'MEDIUM') AS "MEDIUM",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE maintenance_priority = 'HIGH') AS "HIGH",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE maintenance_priority = 'CRITICAL') AS "CRITICAL"
FROM latest;

SELECT
    machine_id AS "Machine",
    priority AS "Priority",
    risk_driver AS "Risk Driver",
    health_score AS "Health Score",
    ROUND((failure_probability * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Failure Probability (%)",
    status AS "Status",
    created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "Created"
FROM maintenance_actions
WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'IN PROGRESS')
ORDER BY
    CASE priority
        WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
        WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    created_at ASC;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    ) AS "Open Actions",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'IN PROGRESS'
    ) AS "In Progress",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'OPEN'
          AND priority = 'CRITICAL'
    ) AS "Critical Open",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
          AND completed_at >= CURRENT_DATE
          AND completed_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
    ) AS "Completed Today"

FROM maintenance_actions;

WITH latest_prediction AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        current_status,
        predictive_state,
        failure_probability,
        timestamp
    FROM predictive_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT
    machine_id AS "Machine",
    current_status AS "Current Status",
    predictive_state AS "Predictive State",
    ROUND((failure_probability * 100)::numeric, 1)
        AS "Failure Probability (%)"
FROM latest_prediction
ORDER BY machine_id;

WITH latest_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        status
    FROM sensor_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Normal"
FROM latest_status
WHERE status = 'NORMAL';

WITH latest_status AS (

        status
    FROM sensor_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Warning"

WHERE status = 'WARNING';

WITH latest_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        status
    FROM sensor_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Failure Risk"
FROM latest_status
WHERE status = 'FAILURE RISK';

WITH latest_prediction AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        predictive_state
    FROM predictive_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Predicted Failure"
FROM latest_prediction
WHERE predictive_state = 'PREDICTED FAILURE';

WITH latest_prediction AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id)
        machine_id,
        predictive_state
    FROM predictive_readings
    WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY machine_id, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Already Failed"
FROM latest_prediction
WHERE predictive_state = 'ALREADY FAILED';

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    machine_id AS metric,
    CASE
        WHEN current_status = 'FAILURE RISK' THEN NULL
        ELSE failure_probability * 100
    END AS value
FROM predictive_readings
WHERE machine_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;
